title: A Log-Timescale Perturbation Bound for Selective State Space Models at Every Sequence Length
abstract: arXiv:2611.21952v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mamba models deployed on streaming data, such as limit order book updates, run far past the sequence lengths they were trained on. A guarantee on how much a small change of input can move the hidden state therefore has to hold at every length. The closest existing bound we know of measures the change of the timescale additively, and it grows linearly with the sequence length unless the timescale is bounded away from zero. In this paper, we measure the change on a log scale instead. The key observation is that the decay factor of each step then moves by at most a fixed fraction of that step's input weight, so the per-step errors cannot pile up. Using this, we prove that two runs of a selective-scan cell from a common start stay within a bound that holds at every length, shrinks to zero with the size of the change and needs no lower bound on the timescale. translated_title: 面向选择性状态空间模型在任意序列长度下的对数时间尺度扰动界
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.21952v1 公告类型：新。摘要：部署在流式数据（如限价订单簿更新）上的 Mamba 模型，其运行长度会远远超出训练时的序列长度。因此，关于输入的微小变化会使隐藏状态移动多少的保证，必须在任意序列长度下都成立。据我们所知，最接近的现有界以加法方式度量时间尺度的变化，除非时间尺度被限制在远离零的范围内，否则该界会随序列长度线性增长。本文改为在对数尺度上度量这种变化。关键观察是：这样一来，每一步的衰减因子最多只会移动该步输入权重的一个固定比例，因此每步的误差不会累积叠加。利用这一结论，我们证明了从同一共同起点出发的选择性扫描（selective-scan）单元的两次运行，始终保持在一个界之内：该界在任意序列长度下都成立、随扰动大小收缩至零，且无需对时间尺度设置任何下界。我们还给出一个构造，表明对于微小扰动，该界在一个常数因子之内……（原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种对数时间尺度上的扰动界，证明选择性状态空间模型（Mamba）中输入的微小变化对隐藏状态的影响在任意序列长度下均有界、误差不随序列长度累积，且无需对时间尺度设置下界。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a log-timescale perturbation bound showing that small input changes to selective state space models (Mamba) affect the hidden state within a bound that holds at every sequence length, prevents per-step error accumulation, and requires no lower bound on the timescale.
